title: 36th sitting of the 20th Majlis

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/36/2024).
Preliminary debate on the bill amending Law No. 2/99 (Maldives Tourism Act), submitted on behalf of the government by Machchangolhi South MP Mustafa Hussain.

Unfinished business: continuation of the debate on the bill amending Law No. 29/2016 (Act on Taxes and Fees Collected from Passengers Departing the Maldives from an Airport), submitted on behalf of the government by Gemanafushi MP Asadhulla Shihab.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was scheduled to debate a government bill amending the Tourism Act and continue debating the airport departure tax bill, then vote.
